name: schedule
description: Schedule commands via transient systemd user timers (agent-tools-<name>.*). once --in/--at for one-shots, recurring --calendar for repeating, list/cancel to manage. No daemon required.
use_when: running a command later or periodically

args.name: once
args.description: --in SPAN (30s, 15min, 2h) or --at 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM', plus --command and optional --name.

stdout: JSON acks; list emits {raw: timers table}.
notes: Units are transient — gone after firing (once) or reboot. For survived-reboot persistence, future: systemd unit files.
